symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with grey centers and brown borders on leaves. Collar rot at base.
causes: High humidity above 90%, temperature 24-28C, excessive nitrogen fertilizer
spread: Wind-borne spores, infected seeds, water splash
organic_control: Neem oil spray (5ml per litre), Trichoderma viride soil application
chemical_control: Tricyclazole 75WP at 0.6g/litre, Isoprothiolane 40EC at 1.5ml/litre

symptoms: Small oval to cylindrical dark brown lesions on leaves.
causes: Nutrient deficiency, specifically nitrogen and potassium. High humidity.
organic_control: Maintain proper soil nutrition, balanced fertilization, use treated seeds
chemical_control: Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/l

symptoms: Water-soaked to yellowish stripes on leaf blades, which later turn brown and dry up.
causes: Heavy rain, high humidity, warm temperatures, excess nitrogen.
spread: Water, wind, infected seeds, and agricultural tools.
organic_control: Avoid excess nitrogen, ensure field drainage, use resistant varieties.
chemical_control: Copper oxychloride at 3g/l combined with Streptomycin at 0.1g/l.

symptoms: Orange-brown, yellow, or black pustules forming streaks or clusters on leaves and stems.
causes: Cool to warm days, cool nights, heavy dew or light rain.
severity: High - spreads across regions via wind.
organic_control: Plant resistant varieties, early sowing, crop rotation.
chemical_control: Propiconazole 25 EC at 1ml/litre or Tebuconazole 250 EC at 1ml/litre.

symptoms: White to pale gray, fuzzy or powdery colonies on upper leaf surfaces and stems.
causes: High humidity, dense plant canopy, cool and damp conditions.
organic_control: Reduce seed rate to allow air flow, balanced nitrogen application.
chemical_control: Sulfur-based fungicides or triadimefon.

symptoms: Ears are replaced by a black powdery mass of spores. Usually visible at heading time.
causes: Infected seeds from the previous season.
severity: High for infected plants, but overall field loss usually moderate.
organic_control: Hot water seed treatment (54°C for 10 mins).
chemical_control: Carboxin 75 WP as seed treatment (2g/kg seed).

symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaves, white mould on undersides, black stem lesions.
causes: Cool temperatures 10-25°C, wet conditions, poor air circulation.
severity: Critical - spreads rapidly, can wipe out field in days.
organic_control: Copper sprays (preventative), remove infected parts immediately.
chemical_control: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP at 2.5g/litre every 7 days.

symptoms: Bullseye shaped brown/black rings on older leaves, lower leaves yellowing.
causes: Warm temperatures, humid conditions, overhead irrigation.
spread: Soil-borne spores splashed onto lower leaves by rain.
organic_control: Mulching, staking, removing bottom leaves, avoid overhead watering.
chemical_control: Chlorothalonil at 2ml/litre or Mancozeb.

symptoms: Severe stunting, upward curling and crinkling of leaves, yellow margins.
causes: Whitefly population explosion.
spread: Transmitted exclusively by the Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).
organic_control: Use yellow sticky traps to catch whiteflies, plant marigolds as trap crops.
chemical_control: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5ml/litre to control the whitefly vector.

symptoms: Holes in squares and bolls, presence of frass (caterpillar droppings). Bolls drop prematurely.
causes: Pest population dynamics during the fruiting stage.
spread: Moths fly at night and lay eggs on the upper side of tender leaves.
organic_control: Release of Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoids, pheromone traps, neem oil.
chemical_control: Spinosad 45 SC at 0.3ml/litre or Emamectin benzoate 5 SG at 0.5g/litre.

symptoms: Downward or upward curling of leaves, thickened veins, enations (leaf-like outgrowths) on the underside.
causes: Presence of whitefly vector and infected alternate hosts.
organic_control: Uproot and burn infected plants, clear alternate weed hosts.
chemical_control: Control vector with systemic insecticides like Acetamiprid 20 SP or Thiamethoxam.

symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions on leaves, often starting on lower leaves.
causes: Moderate temperatures (18-27°C) and heavy dew.
spread: Wind-dispersed spores from infected crop residue.
organic_control: Crop rotation, tilling residue into soil to decompose.
chemical_control: Mancozeb or Pyraclostrobin-based fungicides if severity is high before tasseling.

symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves, large amounts of sawdust-like frass in the leaf whorl.
causes: Fast-breeding pest migration.
spread: Moths migrate vast distances on wind currents.
organic_control: Apply sand or ash into the leaf whorl, release predators like earwigs, Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) sprays.
chemical_control: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC at 0.4 ml/L applied into the whorls.

symptoms: Irregular water-soaked spots, white mold on undersides of leaves in humid weather, tubers rot.
causes: Cool, wet, and humid weather.
organic_control: Use certified disease-free seed potatoes, copper sprays, immediate hum removal.
chemical_control: Chlorothalonil, Cymoxanil + Mancozeb.

symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit. Fruit may crack or deform.
causes: Wet, cool spring weather.
spread: Spores splash from fallen infected leaves onto new growth during spring rains.
organic_control: Orchard sanitation (mulching/removing fallen leaves), sulfur sprays.
chemical_control: Captan 50 WP or Difenoconazole 25 EC.

symptoms: Yellow 'oil spots' on upper leaf surface, white cottony growth on the underside directly below.
causes: Warm, wet, and highly humid conditions.
organic_control: Improve canopy ventilation via pruning, Bordeaux mixture (copper sulfate + lime).
chemical_control: Metalaxyl or Fosetyl-Al.

symptoms: Yellowing/drying of top leaves, splitting the stalk reveals reddened pith with crosswise white patches, sour alcoholic smell.
causes: Waterlogging, use of infected setts.
spread: Irrigation water, infected cutting tools, infected seed setts.
organic_control: Uproot and burn infected clumps, avoid water stagnation.
chemical_control: Pre-planting sett treatment with Carbendazim 50 WP.

symptoms: Small irregular water-soaked spots on leaves, stems, and fruits. Cracks on the fruit surface.
causes: Warm temperatures with rain or high humidity.
spread: Rain splash, pruning tools, infected planting material.
organic_control: Strict orchard hygiene, prune and burn infected parts.
chemical_control: Bordeaux mixture or Streptocycline sprays.

symptoms: Dark brown or black irregular spots on leaves. Blossom blight. Black spots on ripening fruit.
causes: High humidity, continuous rain during flowering.
organic_control: Post-harvest hot water treatment of fruits, prune for better air circulation.
chemical_control: Carbendazim or Copper oxychloride sprays during flowering.

symptoms: Raised, corky, crater-like lesions with yellow halos on leaves, stems, and fruit.
causes: Wind-driven rain, warm temperatures.
spread: Leafminer insect damage facilitates entry, splashing water, human movement.
organic_control: Control citrus leafminer, windbreaks around orchard.
chemical_control: Copper-based bactericides (Bordeaux mixture 1%) sprayed multiple times.

symptoms: Tiny, chlorotic spots on bottom surface of leaves, turning brown and black streaks.
causes: High humidity, poor field drainage.
organic_control: Remove infected leaves, improve drainage.
chemical_control: Propiconazole or Mancozeb sprays.

symptoms: Dark brown circular spots on leaves surrounded by a yellow halo.
causes: Warm and humid climate.
organic_control: Crop rotation, deep summer ploughing.
chemical_control: Chlorothalonil at 2g/litre or Carbendazim at 1g/litre.

symptoms: Drooping of leaves, discoloration of internal stem tissues, wilting in patches.
causes: Soil-borne fungus, moisture stress.
organic_control: Use resistant varieties, seed treatment with Trichoderma viride.
chemical_control: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 2g/kg seed.

symptoms: Small brown/reddish pustules on the underside of leaves.
causes: Extended periods of leaf wetness, temperatures 15-28C.
organic_control: Plant early maturing varieties, wide row spacing.
chemical_control: Tebuconazole 25.9 EC at 1.5ml/litre.
